subject: MedEdge security discovery: retention, deletion, SOC 2 next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MedEdge security discovery — retention & deletion questions (recap + attachments)

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery call focused on retention, deletion SLAs, and SOC 2 / HIPAA posture. I pulled together a very small draft SLA and a starter security QA we usually send to prospects — attaching both.

Summary of what we covered on the call:
- Scope: Redwood hosted API for inference (no long-term storage of PII by default; customer-owned vectors optional)
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in production; happy to share the latest report under an NDA
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA workflows; BAAs available for Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Retention / deletion: baseline platform policies vs. contractable SLAs (we need to confirm exact timeframes you require)
- Logs & backups: we discussed audit/log retention and backup lifecycle — need to confirm whether 90/180-day defaults meet MedEdge needs or if you require shorter windows for PHI

Attachments: SLA_Draft_20261008.docx (redlineable), MedEdge_Security_QA_v1.pdf (starter answers).

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) Priya / Tom: please indicate (A) whether you need SOC 2 report now and (B) whether you require HIPAA BAA before POC.
2) Redwood: Sergio & Mina to provide a short technical note on exact retention windows for logs, backups, and deletion timelines (we'll call this out in the SLA).
3) We propose starting your vendor security questionnaire (we can pre-populate answers and then send the file back) — I’ve attached a small initiation stub to show format.

Would it work if Sergio followed up with the technical note by EOD tomorrow? If so, we can then propose an SLA clause and send a formal questionnaire response the following day.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,

--
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: MedEdge security discovery — retention & deletion questions (recap + attachments)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the recap and attachments, that was helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- SOC 2: We do need to see the latest Type II report for our procurement review. NDA shouldn’t be a blocker — happy to sign.
- HIPAA / BAA: We need clarity on whether the hosted API qualifies for a BAA or if we must use a Dedicated or Private deployment to be covered. If a BAA is only available for Dedicated/Private, please say so clearly.
- Retention: two quick, practical questions —
  1) What is Redwood’s default retention for application logs that may contain PII/PHI?
  2) For backups: how long do you retain backups by default, and what is the deletion timeline after a data deletion request (i.e., does an on-demand deletion remove backups immediately or only after retention period)?

If you can get us answers to the two retention questions and a timeline for when you can share SOC 2, we can kick off the internal security review. Also, we’ll attach our vendor security questionnaire once we confirm NDA.

Best,
Priya
Head of Platform Security | MedEdge Health
priya.suresh@mededgehealth.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@mededgehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MedEdge security discovery — retention & deletion questions (recap + attachments)

Hi Priya —

Quick technical answers below; I’ll flag any items that typically become contract language. Short version first, then the specifics.

Short answers (contractable):
- Application logs (default): 90 days (audit logs retained for 90 days). Can be extended in contract to meet compliance needs.
- Backups: default retention is 180 days for full backups.
- Deletion SLA: primary data deletion (live indexes/vector stores/metadata) — typically completed within 30 days of a validated request; backups are removed according to backup window and may persist up to the configured retention (default 180 days) unless we contractually agree to accelerated purge windows (we can offer a 90-day or 30-day backup purge as a paid SLA in Dedicated/Private options).

Notes / context:
- Our hosted API is multi-tenant for the entry-level plan; however, PII/PHI should be isolated via customer-specific buckets and optional private deployments for full isolation.
- For HIPAA: BAAs are available but typically require Dedicated or Private deployment — we can discuss an exception path but it requires legal review.
- SOC 2: we can provide the latest Type II report under NDA within 2 business days after agreement signature or NDA execution; for mid-cycle requests we have a redacted interim packet for initial review.

Related links: internal log retention policy (copied here for quick reference) — https://redwood.internal/docs/log-retention-policy-v1

If you want, I can draft the specific SLA language to be inserted into the contract (e.g., audit-log retention = 90d; backup retention = 180d; deletion timeline = 30d for primary, 180d for backups unless purged earlier via contractual SLA). Camila — I can send that by EOD today.

Thanks,
Sergio
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.com

3) Priya — once NDA is signed we’ll upload the SOC 2 Type II and the redacted interim report; we can also pre-fill your vendor questionnaire and return it as a draft for you to review.

I’m attaching a minimal vendor questionnaire initiation file (Vendor_QS_Initiation.json) that shows the sections we typically prefill to speed the review.
